authorization by 24:00. End date of the POP is agreed to get an extension to 6/22/2026.

38BC116801
(F/O) EXSA-ZC00 SA 96350D 02 LEVEL BERP, INSTALL

CONTRACTOR QUESTION:
Q7
I would like to clarify the intent of my previous inquiry. My question was focused on eligibility regarding the contractor's nationality.
Previously, I understood that for non-CMAV (Continuous Maintenance Availability) repair projects, only U.S. companies were eligible to bid. 
However, since DFARS 252.225-7042 primarily discusses the legal authority to operate within Japan, I wanted to confirm whether Japanese or South Korean companies are also eligible to participate in this specific solicitation.
As my inquiry was related to administrative eligibility rather than the technical scope of work, I reached out via email.

GOVERNMENT RESPONSE:
A7
Please confirm Section A, L, and M in the solicitation about eligibility for bidding. Regarding this questions, the language in Section A has been updated. Please confirm for the changes as well.

All other information remains unchanged.
See continuation page for details.

USS JOHN FINN (DDG-113) Chief of Naval Operation Availability (CNO):

NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (NAVSUP FLCY) has a new requirement

in support of USS JOHN FINN (DDG-113) and US Naval Ship Repair Facility

and Japan Regional Maintenance Center (SRF-JRMC). The work is composed of

twelve (12) Task Group Instructions (TGIs) of various ship repair

overhaul, preservation, and replacement work onboard the ship.

Offers will be received until 17 Dec 2025, 10:00 AM (Please submit your

proposal to " kazuo.takamura.ln@us.navy.mil " in TO line)

PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: 20 Apr 2026 through 22 Jun 2026

PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Yokosuka Naval Base, Yokosuka, JAPAN

References in the Work Items will be provided to offerors via DoD safe (a

web-based tool that provides users the capability to securely send and

receive large files, including files that are too large to be transmitted

via email.)

Please email request for references to:

Kazuo Takamura (kazuo.takamura.ln@us.navy.mil)

Ai Gillard (ai.gillard.ln@us.navy.mil)

When submitting your proposal, you must specify any hazardous material in

accordance with FAR 52.223-3 (Hazardous Material ID) and DFARS 252.223-7001.

When submitting your proposal, you must specify if you anticipate sea

transportation in accordance with DFARS 252.247-7022.

If there is a time limit on your offer, you must specify this at submission

of your proposal.

If there are any amendments to this RFP, please acknowledge them when

submitting your proposal in the proposal comment section.
